sourceNotes: 新增 XStats Capture 截图标注工具
截图新增马赛克与本地一键打码，可识别手机号、邮箱等敏感文字并编辑遮挡范围
新增带系统声音和麦克风的录屏，支持倒计时、暂停续录、录制计时、预览裁剪和 MP4 导出
完善诊断导出说明并显示实际处理阶段，减少启动和导出时主线程上的签名检查等待
优化监控、AI 用量与清理任务的资源管理，减少不必要的格式化、子进程等待唤醒及关闭后的后台工作
隐藏未启用护眼功能的快捷键设置，改善特殊按键名称显示并补齐小组件与截图工具的多语言文案
加固风扇自动恢复与控制状态确认，读取或复位失败时不再误报已交还系统，并修复保护流程回归
修复部分本地磁盘容量口径为零时错误显示无可用空间的问题，并加固内存释放统计和异常输入处理
修复截图保存、录屏写入与导出的边界问题，保护已有文件和其他会话素材，失败或取消后保留可恢复内容

en: Add optional XStats Capture with region, window, and full-screen screenshots, cropping, arrows, rectangles, freehand drawing, text, undo/redo, and pinned images. It is off by default and can be enabled in feature settings

Add mosaic redaction and local sensitive-text detection for phone numbers, email addresses, and other supported patterns. Adjust the resulting masks before sharing; images stay on this Mac and automatic detection still requires manual review

Add screen recording with system audio and microphone options, a countdown, pause/resume, elapsed time, preview trimming, and MP4 export. Configure screenshot and recording shortcuts and clean up recording leftovers on demand while protecting media still in use
Clarify diagnostic export contents and show actual processing stages. Move signing checks off the main thread during startup and export to reduce waiting
Improve resource management for monitoring, AI usage, and cleanup tasks, reducing unnecessary formatting, subprocess wait wakeups, and background work after closing views
Hide eye-care shortcut settings when the feature is disabled, show readable names for special keys, and complete widget and capture-tool translations
Strengthen automatic fan recovery and control-state verification. Failed reads or resets no longer report that control has returned to macOS, and safety-flow regressions are fixed
Fix local disks incorrectly showing no available space when a capacity reading is zero, and harden memory-release statistics and invalid-input handling
Fix screenshot saving and recording write/export edge cases. Protect existing files and other recording sessions, and preserve recoverable media after failures or cancellation
